description: BCM software image management service providing CRUD operations for OS images used in DPU node provisioning

addSoftwareImage.description: Create a new software image, optionally cloning from an existing image

args.name: entity
args.description: Software image entity with all configuration

args.name: cloneData
args.description: Whether to clone filesystem from originalImage (true for clones, false for new images)

returns.description: UUID string directly, OR object with 'updated_entity' field containing full entity

notes: Returns UUID immediately but clone is async (poll fileOperationInProgress)
originalImage field only valid during create (reset after clone completes)
kernel_version validation may fail if set before clone completes (use two-step pattern)

getSoftwareImage.description: Retrieve a single software image by name (efficient direct lookup)

args.name: name
args.description: Exact software image name to lookup

returns.description: Full software image entity if found, null if not found

notes: Preferred over getSoftwareImages for single image lookup
Returns null rather than error for not-found cases
originalImage field may be zero UUID or empty string after clone

getSoftwareImages.description: List all software images in the BCM cluster

returns.description: Array of all software image entities

performance.use_cases: Data source listing, polling for clone status

notes: Use for list operations and data sources
Less efficient than getSoftwareImage for single lookups
Currently used in clone polling (should optimize to getSoftwareImage)

updateSoftwareImage.description: Update an existing software image's configuration

args.name: entity
args.description: Complete software image entity with UUID field included

returns.description: Success returns empty response, errors return error object

requirements: Include all fields (changed and unchanged) to prevent field reset
notes: Must provide complete entity (partial updates not supported)
kernel_version path validation may fail during clone (use two-step pattern)
Call getSoftwareImage after update to refresh state

removeSoftwareImage.description: Delete a software image from the BCM cluster

args.name: uuid
args.description: UUID of software image to delete

args.name: removeData
args.description: Whether to remove filesystem data (false for standard delete)

args.name: removeAll
args.description: Whether to remove all related entities (false for standard delete)

args.name: force
args.description: Whether to force deletion ignoring dependencies (false for safe delete)

error_cases.response: {"error": "Cannot delete image: in use by <N> nodes"}

notes: Standard deletion (all flags false) is safe and recommended
force=true bypasses dependency checks (dangerous in production)

error_response.detection: Check for 'error' key in response object

null_response.handling: Check for null or empty object before unmarshaling

original_image_reset.behavior: BCM resets originalImage field to zero UUID or empty string after clone completes
original_image_reset.impact: Terraform must preserve plan value in state for audit trail
original_image_reset.workaround: Check plan for known value, use plan value if present

kernel_validation_timing.behavior: BCM validates kernel_version path BEFORE clone completes
kernel_validation_timing.impact: Setting kernel_version during create with originalImage may fail
kernel_validation_timing.workaround: Two-step pattern: create basic config, then update with kernel config

module_parameters_type.behavior: BCM expects parameters field to be string type, rejects null
module_parameters_type.impact: Empty parameters must be empty string, not null
module_parameters_type.workaround: Set parameters to '' if null or omitted

uuid_response_formats.behavior: addSoftwareImage may return UUID as string or nested in object
uuid_response_formats.workaround: Try direct string first, then check for updated_entity.uuid

clone_operation.status_check: Call getSoftwareImage (or getSoftwareImages), check fileOperationInProgress field
clone_operation.timeout_handling: Soft timeout (log warning, proceed) rather than hard failure

error_scenarios: Invalid originalImage UUID (expect error during addSoftwareImage)
edge_cases: Concurrent creates with unique names (should succeed)
kernel_version during create (may fail, use two-step pattern)
